subject.title: feat #94529: auto-derive session title in sidebar

question: Should maintainers still pursue this narrow `includeDerivedTitles` PR after generated `displayName` titles merged on main and a broader accessible session-history PR now overlaps it?
rationale: Current main partially solves the user-facing sidebar-title problem through a different implementation, while this PR still has a small correctness defect, missing proof, and merge conflicts; automation cannot safely choose the intended product path.

options.title: Prefer current main and the broader path
options.body: Treat merged generated titles and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96267 as the canonical direction, then close or ask the author to withdraw this conflicting narrow branch.

options.title: Revive the narrow PR
options.body: Ask for a rebase onto current `ui/src/lib/*` paths, a `derivedTitle !== key` guard in the shared helper, and exact-head sidebar plus picker browser proof.

options.title: Pause until issue triage settles
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94529 is re-triaged against current main and the overlap is resolved.

recommendation.title: Prefer current main and the broader path
recommendation.body: Treat merged generated titles and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96267 as the canonical direction, then close or ask the author to withdraw this conflicting narrow branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged generated-title work is the current main implementation most directly competing with this PR’s narrow path.
